summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `import enum` and the str-valued EndpointResolverBuiltins enum with all eleven members, each commented with meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept endpoint_config=None (no variant tags); added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults. The SDK::Endpoint key is always present, with value None when absent. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion, including the single custom-data legacy and single bundled-data tests. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 59 passed; test_regions, test_client, test_endpoint, and test_args together 443 passed. Not verified: black, isort, and flake8 are not installed in the shared venv and were not installed; line lengths were checked directly (no added line over 79 columns). Nothing committed.
